"'''Grimey'''" was a [[Nanism|diminutive]] individual who lived on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Crisis]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he was seen roaming the streets of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] shortly before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Grimey" was the on-stage nickname given to one of the four characters played by [[Warwick Davis]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the other three being [[W. Wald|Wald]], [[Weazel/Legends|Weazel]], and, briefly, a walking [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="Valley">{{InsiderCite|67|Beyond the Valley of the Ewoks}}</ref>
